content.title: KITCHEN HABITS THAT {{DESTROY}} YOUR NUTRIENTS
facts: **Broccoli** – Boiling it lets water-soluble **vitamin C** leach straight into the pot; steaming for a few minutes keeps far more intact.
**Tomatoes** – Putting unripe ones in the fridge halts the enzymes that build flavor and **lycopene**; leave them at room temperature until fully ripe.
**Mushrooms** – A quick rinse is fine, but soaking them in water makes them absorb liquid like a sponge, diluting flavor and nutrients alike.
**Rice** – Over-rinsing fortified white rice washes away added **folic acid** and other nutrients coating the grains; a light rinse is enough.
**Spinach** – Eating it only raw limits how much **iron** and **calcium** your body can actually absorb; a brief sauté breaks down the oxalates blocking them.
**Avocado** – Leaving the cut flesh exposed speeds up oxidation and **vitamin E** loss; press plastic wrap directly onto the surface to slow it down.
